Nodes.Text: Warm hearth, dry beds, and no questions about the mud on your boots. A room is ten drams — best sleep in the village, and the world keeps turning while you get it.

Choices.Text: About that thing you mentioned — tell me the rest.
[10 drams] Take a room and rest.
What do you hear around the hearth?

Nodes.Text: Travelers bring news of nearby settlements. I can mark directions in your travel notes; they start from here. Ask there about local work.
The innkeeper leans in. "Between us? A merchant came through pale as bone, wouldn't say what he saw on the old road. Ask me again sometime — maybe I'll have pieced it together."
"Pieced it together, I have. The pale merchant saw LIGHTS in the ruins — moving in ranks, like a procession. No lantern walks in ranks. Whatever marches out there, it isn't looking for trade."
